input: Find family-owned German machine-tool manufacturers (Mittelstand) with 100-500 employees

companies.name: HEDELIUS Maschinenfabrik GmbH
companies.employees: Approximately 250; as_of=2026-11-10, observation of undated association profile; source_url=https://www.vdwf.de/netzwerk/mitglieder/hedelius-maschinenfabrik-gmbh.html

criteria_evidence.evidence: Describes itself as an independent family company with substantial in-house manufacturing.
VDWF identifies HEDELIUS Maschinenfabrik GmbH in Meppen, its domain and its founding year.
Develops and manufactures vertical CNC travelling-column machining centres and associated automation.
VDWF reports approximately 250 employees; observed as_of=2026-11-10.

companies.traction: More than 3,000 machining centres delivered; as_of=2026-11-10, observation of undated association profile; source_url=https://www.vdwf.de/netzwerk/mitglieder/hedelius-maschinenfabrik-gmbh.html
companies.rank_reason: Especially clear fit: explicitly independent and family-owned, focused on CNC machine tools, with headcount comfortably inside the requested range.

companies.name: AXA Entwicklungs- und Maschinenbau GmbH
companies.employees: Approximately 320; as_of=2026-11-10, observation of undated company profile; source_url=https://www.axa-maschinenbau.de/das-unternehmen

criteria_evidence.evidence: Explicitly describes AXA as a family company and a German medium-sized machinery manufacturer.
Names AXA Entwicklungs- und Maschinenbau GmbH and its headquarters and manufacturing operation in Schöppingen.
The anniversary history distinguishes the original business founded in 1965 from the newly established AXA Entwicklungs- und Maschinenbau GmbH in June 1975; the latter is used here.
Develops and manufactures machine tools, machining centres and core machine components; reports 320 employees, observed as_of=2026-11-10.

companies.traction: TKM commissioned an AXA travelling-column machining centre at its Böhlerwerk operation; as_of=2025-06-12; source_url=https://www.axa-maschinenbau.de/fileadmin/axa-maschinenbau/press/Effizienzsteigerung_bei_TKM_Austria_06-2025.pdf
companies.rank_reason: Direct family-company evidence, substantial proprietary manufacturing and an attractive mid-range workforce; strong customer-specific machining-centre focus.

companies.name: ELHA-MASCHINENBAU Liemke GmbH & Co. KG

criteria_evidence.evidence: The company brochure explicitly identifies the named entity as a medium-sized family company.
Company history places its origins around 1930 and identifies the operating company and its headquarters in Hövelhof. The founding year is approximate.
Manufactures machining centres, vertical turning-milling centres, transfer machines and customer-specific cutting-machine systems.
Reports 240 employees in its January 2026 brochure.

companies.headcount_growth: as_of=2022-05: 240 employees, source_url=https://www.elha.de/wp-content/uploads/fs-de-05.2022-web.pdf; as_of=2026-01: 240 employees, source_url=https://www.elha.de/wp-content/uploads/FS-DE-01-2026.pdf. Published counts are unchanged.
companies.traction: Published customer references include Robert Bosch, Volkswagen and Deutsche Bahn; as_of=2026-11-10, observation of undated reference list; source_url=https://www.elha.de/kompetenzen/referenzen/
companies.rank_reason: Strong family-owned machine-tool fit with recent, explicitly dated workforce evidence and a broad industrial customer base.

companies.name: F. Zimmermann GmbH
companies.employees: Approximately 190 worldwide; as_of=2026-11-10, observation of undated company careers page; source_url=https://www.f-zimmermann.com/karriere/

criteria_evidence.evidence: Identifies itself as family-run; its history records the Gänzle family's acquisition and subsequent family management succession.
Names F. Zimmermann GmbH, its headquarters in Neuhausen and its founding year.
Develops and manufactures CNC portal milling machines for aerospace and automotive applications.
Reports 190 employees worldwide; observed as_of=2026-11-10.

companies.traction: Publishes a customer testimonial from Saab AB project manager Björn Leidelöf concerning its aerospace machining equipment; as_of=2026-11-10; source_url=https://www.f-zimmermann.com/aerospace/
companies.rank_reason: Focused high-precision milling OEM with explicit family ownership and an unambiguous worldwide workforce within range.

companies.name: FOOKE GmbH
companies.employees: Approximately 200 at Borken; as_of=2026-11-10, observation of undated company careers page; source_url=https://www.fooke-machines.com/karriere/vorteile-bei-fooke

criteria_evidence.evidence: Company history identifies continuing ownership and management by the Fooke family across successive generations.
Names FOOKE GmbH, its Borken headquarters and its founding year.
Manufactures five-axis portal milling machines, large-format machining systems and specialised friction-stir-welding equipment.
Company careers page reports approximately 200 employees at its Borken operating location; observed as_of=2026-11-10.

companies.headcount_growth: as_of=2024-06-18: more than 200 employees, source_url=https://www.fooke-machines.com/fileadmin/blog_termine/Borkener_Zeitung_Aktuelle_Situation_und_120_Jahre_18.06.2024.pdf; as_of=2026-11-10: approximately 200 at Borken, source_url=https://www.fooke-machines.com/karriere/vorteile-bei-fooke. Rounded counts and differing wording do not establish a precise growth rate.
companies.traction: Local-business interview reports an order for two machines for an Airbus assembly line in Tianjin; as_of=2024-06-18; source_url=https://www.fooke-machines.com/fileadmin/blog_termine/Borkener_Zeitung_Aktuelle_Situation_und_120_Jahre_18.06.2024.pdf
companies.rank_reason: Clear multigenerational family ownership and differentiated large-format machine tools, supported by named aerospace customer evidence.

companies.name: Adelbert Haas GmbH

criteria_evidence.evidence: Company explicitly identifies itself as a family enterprise; the World Market Leader Index identifies ownership by a successor family rather than the founding family.
Company history records its founding and identifies Adelbert Haas GmbH at its Trossingen headquarters.
Develops and manufactures Multigrind precision grinding machines, automation and proprietary grinding software.
World Market Leader Index reports 216 employees, as_of=2025.

companies.headcount_growth: as_of=2015: 150 employees under the former Haas Schleifmaschinen name, source_url=https://bs-as.de/fileadmin/user_upload/Treffpunkt_Wirtschaft/Frueher/Tagungsband_Treffpunkt_Wirtschaft_2015.pdf; as_of=2025: 216 employees, source_url=https://www.weltmarktfuehrerindex.de/profil/-8180. This is a long-term comparison, not a recent annual growth measure.
companies.traction: Reported revenue of EUR 58,335,933; as_of=2025, using the source's year label; source_url=https://www.weltmarktfuehrerindex.de/profil/-8180
companies.rank_reason: Specialist grinding-machine OEM with recent dated headcount and revenue evidence; successor-family ownership still meets the family-owned criterion.

companies.name: Heinz Berger Maschinenfabrik GmbH & Co. KG
companies.employees: 162 at year-end for the named operating entity; as_of=2023-12-31; source_url=https://fusionbase.com/en/data/organization/23622a60a163babe1a370a6f10a0cd5a/heinz-berger-maschinenfabrik-gmbh-&-co.-kg

criteria_evidence.evidence: Describes the business as a medium-sized family company in its third generation; the operating company is identified in the page footer.
Identifies Heinz Berger Maschinenfabrik GmbH & Co. KG as the operating company behind the Berger Gruppe, founded in 1957 and based in Wuppertal.
Manufactures CNC and robotic machines for grinding, polishing, sharpening and gear-related machining.
Reproduced operating-company annual report records 162 employees at year-end, as_of=2023-12-31. Group figures are not substituted for this entity count.

companies.traction: Operating-company revenue of EUR 29.735 million; as_of=2023 financial year; source_url=https://fusionbase.com/en/data/organization/23622a60a163babe1a370a6f10a0cd5a/heinz-berger-maschinenfabrik-gmbh-&-co.-kg
companies.rank_reason: Strong family ownership and specialised machine-tool manufacturing; ranked below the most current disclosures because the exact-entity workforce figure is older.

companies.name: Wilhelm Bahmüller Maschinenbau Präzisionswerkzeuge GmbH
companies.employees: 385 in the year-end headcount passage; as_of=2023-12-31. The same filing reports 400 total staff elsewhere, so the precise count is internally inconsistent, but both are within range; source_url=https://fusionbase.com/en/data/organization/8c1b6c815115632c4abb7844268aa803/wilhelm-b-a-h-m-%C3%BC-l-l-e-r-maschinenbau-pr%C3%A4zisionswerkzeuge-gmbh

criteria_evidence.evidence: Company explicitly describes itself as a family enterprise; registry-derived ownership information also identifies Christoph Bahmüller as the majority shareholder.
Company history records the establishment of Wilhelm Bahmüller's mechanical workshop in Plüderhausen in 1945.
Its precision-grinding division develops and manufactures grinding machines and integrated high-precision production systems.
The operating-company filing reports workforce counts within the requested interval, as_of=2023-12-31; the conflicting counts are disclosed in the employees field.

companies.traction: Reported revenue of approximately EUR 93.4 million; as_of=2023 financial year; source_url=https://fusionbase.com/en/data/organization/8c1b6c815115632c4abb7844268aa803/wilhelm-b-a-h-m-%C3%BC-l-l-e-r-maschinenbau-pr%C3%A4zisionswerkzeuge-gmbh
companies.rank_reason: Verified family control and proprietary precision-grinding machinery; diversified packaging activities and inconsistent workforce reporting reduce relative fit.

companies.name: DREISTERN GmbH & Co. KG
companies.employees: Approximately 185; as_of=2026-11-10, observation of undated company profile; source_url=https://www.dreistern.com/en/company/about-us

criteria_evidence.evidence: Identifies the Krückels family as the owners and managers across successive generations.
Names DREISTERN GmbH & Co. KG in Schopfheim and records its founding year.
Develops and manufactures roll-forming machines and systems, including punching and cut-off equipment.

companies.headcount_growth: as_of=2024 anniversary release: approximately 185 employees, source_url=https://www.dreistern.com/files/dreistern/images/news/Press_release_on_the_75th_anniversary_of_DREISTERN_GmbH___Co._KG.pdf; as_of=2026-11-10: 185 employees on the company profile, source_url=https://www.dreistern.com/en/company/about-us. Published rounded counts are unchanged.
companies.traction: More than 2,000 roll-forming systems manufactured for customers worldwide; as_of=2026-11-10; source_url=https://www.dreistern.com/en/company/about-us

companies.employees: Approximately 200 worldwide; as_of=2026-11-10, observation of undated company careers page; source_url=https://www.arku.com/en/careers

companies.name: Gebr. SAACKE GmbH & Co. KG

companies.name: KUNZMANN Maschinenbau GmbH

criteria_evidence.evidence: Company-issued release identifies ownership by the Eisler family group and explicitly states that KUNZMANN remains legally and organisationally independent.
Identifies KUNZMANN Maschinenbau GmbH, its Remchingen headquarters and founding year.

companies.headcount_growth: as_of=2021-06-01: 110 employees, source_url=https://www.weiler.de/wp-content/uploads/WEILER-KUNZMANN-PI-AustrianSkills-18.11.2021.pdf; as_of=2026-07-22: 110 employees, source_url=https://www.firmenpresse.de/pressinfo2263652-drehen-und-fraesen-in-hoechster-praezision-weiler-und-kunzmann-zeigen-auf-der-amb-26-maschinen.html. companies.traction: Ludwig-Bölkow-Schule in Donauwörth selected and received a KUNZMANN milling machine following a competitive procurement; as_of=2026-07-14 reporting on delivery in late 2025; source_url=https://fraesen24.com/konventionelle-fraesmaschine-mit-neu-entwickelter-streckensteuerung/

companies.name: Supfina Grieshaber GmbH & Co. KG

companies.name: Waldrich Siegen Werkzeugmaschinen GmbH
companies.employees: Approximately 200; as_of=2026-11-10, observation of current employer disclosure; source_url=https://www.herkulesgroup.de/karriere/jobs-dienstleistung-verwaltung/Konstrukteur-alle-Geschlechter-de-j87.html

Current official posting for Waldrich Siegen Werkzeugmaschinen GmbH reports 200 employees, separately from group workforce figures.

companies.traction: Zhejiang Juyuan Power Equipment ordered two high-performance horizontal lathes; as_of=2026-02-17; source_url=https://www.waldrichsiegen.de/detailseite-news/mit-maschinen-von-waldrichsiegen-zielstrebig-zur-marktspitze/

output.search_notes: Research cutoff: 2026-11-10. Scope includes metal-cutting, grinding, finishing and metal-forming machine tools; excludes machine distributors, contract machinists, cutting-tool-only suppliers and general machinery companies without verified machine-tool manufacturing. The screening unit is the named operating company. Distinct operating subsidiaries of family industrial groups are included and identified; parent-group headcounts are not assigned to them. Ranking favours focused manufacturers, clear family control, independence and stronger or newer evidence. An observation date on an undated webpage is not a claim that the underlying figure was updated that day. Historical disclosures remain explicitly dated. Sources used include VDWF membership records, company histories and news, trade-fair announcements, local business reporting and commercial-register-derived filings. Registry aggregators are not represented as authenticated state-register extracts, and full beneficial-ownership diligence was not available for every company. No disclosed PE owner was identified for the returned companies in the reviewed sources; family-company descriptions alone do not substitute for transaction-stage shareholder diligence. Notable exclusions: WEILER reports approximately 550 employees, source_url=https://www.weiler.de/stellen-2-3/; KERN became part of AMETEK in 2025, source_url=https://www.kern-microtechnik.com/en/About-us; Benzinger is majority-backed by Syngroh, whose transaction was described as private equity, checked against company news and the investor portfolio, source_urls=https://www.benzinger.de/de/aktuelles-2.html, https://www.grohe-fo.de/beteiligungen, https://www.arcuscapital.de/images/Artikel/Handelsblatt-24.04.2024-Seite-33.pdf1.pdf. Thielenhaus was omitted because registry-derived information identifies an investment-company majority rather than verified controlling family ownership, source_url=https://handelsregister.ai/de/organizations/wuppertal/herstellung-von-pruefmaschinen/thielenhaus-technologies-gmbh-74c4b34a9e6279eb1515fcb592e7bbeb. Röders and LASCO were omitted because worldwide disclosures exceed the ceiling or conflict with smaller domestic/entity figures; German-site counts were not substituted, source_urls=https://petpla.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/Roeders-NPE-2024.pdf, https://www.lasco.com/images/pdfs/prospekte/LASCO-Ausbildung.pdf. missing_fields: last_round for every returned company; no latest financing round could be verified, which does not establish that no financing occurred. headcount_growth is missing for HEDELIUS, AXA, F. Zimmermann, Heinz Berger, Bahmüller, SAACKE, Supfina, HEGENSCHEIDT-MFD and Waldrich Siegen because two sufficiently attributable and comparable dated counts were not verified. Published rounded or interval counts are retained without inventing growth percentages. Founding years distinguish a newly formed or merged operating entity where the company's history explicitly does so; other years follow the operating business's stated history. All companies whose core criteria were verified in this research are returned; this is not a complete census of Germany.
